description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the CashPaymentMethod class within the Goteo payment system, specifically focusing on instantiation, ID retrieval, and configuration of commissions.

classes.name: CashPaymentMethodTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the behavior of the CashPaymentMethod class within the Goteo payment module.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Tests the instantiation of the CashPaymentMethod class and verifies it is an instance of the correct class.

methods.name: testId
methods.description: Verifies that the getId method of CashPaymentMethod returns the string 'cash'.

methods.name: testComissions
methods.description: Sets configuration values for commissions related to cash payments and is intended to test commission calculations (not fully implemented).
